_note: The PulseBlockz gradient: the default character skin (pulseblockz_world.cpp, through the pulse_gradient.gen.h SConstruct writes from this file), and scripts/prep-gradient.js's pulse-gradient.png, which the cane's orb and the Engram wear. One definition, so they cannot drift. Colours are sRGB 0..1; blended cubically in OKLab between stops.
